chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih that Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said:

Regarding two sisters who were given to two brothers, and the wife of this one was brought to that one and the wife of that one to this one, he said: “Each one of them is entitled to the dowry because of consummation. If their guardian deliberately did that, he must bear the dowry. Neither of the two men may approach his wife until the waiting period ('iddah) ends. Then when the waiting period ends, each woman returns to her first husband by the first marriage contract.”
It was said to him: “What if they both die before the end of the waiting period?” He said: “The two husbands recover half of the dowry from their heirs, and the two men inherit from them.”

It was said: “Then what if the two husbands die while the two women are in the waiting period?” He said: “The two women inherit from them, and for them is half of the dowry, and upon them is the waiting period; after they finish the first waiting period, they observe the waiting period of a woman whose husband has died.”

key_terms.وَرَثَتِهِمَا: their heirs from whom financial recovery is made
key_terms.وَلِيُّهُمَا: their guardian responsible if he intentionally caused the mix-up
key_terms.ٱلصَّدَاقُ: the dower owed to the wife due in this case because of consummation
key_terms.ٱلنِّكَاحِ: the marriage contract by which each woman returns to her original husband
key_terms.ٱلْعِدَّةُ: the legally mandated waiting period before resuming marital relations or entering the next legal state
key_terms.ٱلْغِشْيَانِ: sexual consummation that establishes the dowry ruling here
key_terms.ٱلْمَهْرِ: the marital dower, here specified as half in the case of death

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if two wives are mistakenly sent to the wrong husbands and consummation occurs?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings for a mistaken marital exchange between two sisters and two brothers after consummation has occurred. It establishes entitlement to dowry, the obligation of 'iddah before returning to the original marriage, and the rulings of inheritance and half-dowry if death occurs during the waiting periods.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4469 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Salih that Abu Abdullah (as) said regarding two sisters who were given in marriage to two brothers, but each was mistakenly sent to the other brother.
Abu Abdullah (as) said: "Each woman is entitled to the dowry due to consummation. If their guardian deliberately caused this mix-up, he must pay the dowry.
Neither man may approach his wife until her waiting period ('iddah) ends. Once the waiting period is over, each woman returns to her original husband based on the first marriage contract."
It was asked: "What if the women die before the waiting period ends?"
Imam (as) said: "The husbands may reclaim half of the dowry from their heirs, and the two husbands inherit from them."
It was further asked: "What if the husbands die while the wives are still in the waiting period?"
Imam (as) said: "The wives inherit from their husbands and are entitled to half of the dowry. After completing the waiting period for the first incident, they must observe another waiting period as widows of their deceased husbands."
